data.name: ShortcutsHelp
data.value:
F9 (or F5) Execute the selection; without a selection, the WHOLE editor: several statements run in order and stop at the first error; a COMMIT or ROLLBACK written in the script is executed (in the tab of a procedure, trigger, view or function: compile it) Ctrl+Enter Execute only the statement where the cursor is Ctrl+F9 Run as a script, without the grid (long scripts: thousands of INSERT or UPDATE) Esc Cancel the execution Ctrl+Alt+C / Ctrl+Alt+R Commit / Rollback Ctrl+Space Autocomplete (tables, columns by alias) Ctrl+wheel / Ctrl+0 Enlarge or shrink the editor font / reset it to the Options size Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+5 Results, Plan, Statistics, History, Messages Ctrl+6 Dependencies (in an object tab) Ctrl+7 Data (in a table or view tab)
Tabs (each with its own database and transaction): Ctrl+T New tab on the same database Ctrl+W (or Ctrl+F4) Close the tab (middle click too) Ctrl+Tab Go to the next one (Ctrl+Shift+Tab: the previous one) Ctrl+Shift+F Search metadata (sources, names, columns, descriptions) F9 in the monitor Refresh (Tools → Monitoring)
In the grid: Click a header Sort (again: reverse; Ctrl+click: remove) "Filter" row Click and type: text, PÉREZ*, >100, 2026-07-01, null Drag a header Onto the panel above to group Right-click the footer Choose totals (sum, average, min., max., count) Ctrl+C / Ctrl+Shift+C Copy cell / row with headers (with several rows selected, Ctrl+C copies them all) Shift+click, Ctrl+click Select a range of rows / add single rows Ctrl+A Select all rows Right-click “Copy all rows”, “Copy column”
In the Data tab (nothing is saved until “Apply”): Double-click, F2, type Edit the cell (Enter saves and moves down, Tab moves right, Esc cancels) Del Mark or unmark the selected rows for deletion Right-click “Set to NULL”, “Undo the row's changes”
In the tree: Double-click a database Connect and use it in the tab Double-click an object Open its DDL in a tab (procedures, triggers, views and functions are edited and compiled there) Double-click a column Insert the name into the editor
